dimensions.assessment: Applies locally to a single specific geographic location in Utah County, Utah, and specific local permit applicants.
dimensions.evidence: the peak within the Uinta National Forest overlooking Utah Valley and located approximately at latitude 40 16'18.14" N, longitude 111 36'58.57" W

dimensions.assessment: Local effect limited to the administration of a single special use permit for a flagpole and associated access.
dimensions.evidence: issue a special use permit for a period of 10 years for the installation, operation, maintenance, and removal ... of a covered flagpole

dimensions.assessment: Exempts the permit holder from land use and cost recovery fees, resulting in negligible fiscal impact.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall not assess any land use fees with respect to a special use permit issued under this section.

dimensions.assessment: Narrowly targets a single administrative permit and exempts it from standard National Environmental Policy Act procedures.
dimensions.evidence: The National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 ... shall not apply to the issuance, renewal, or administration of a special use permit under this section

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a 10-year permit duration with provisions for subsequent renewal.
dimensions.evidence: issue a special use permit for a period of 10 years ... The Secretary shall renew or issue a new 10-year special use permit

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates the issuance of a specific 10-year special use permit exempt from land use fees, cost recovery fees, and environmental reviews for maintaining an American flag flagpole at Kyhv Peak Lookout Point in Utah.
